notes:
可以安装拆成素材包的 Mod。CUT Guide 1.1.0 的文字和视频会按原来的文件夹放进游戏，不再拼成一个 DLL。这版以下的管理器会被拦住，不会开始下载。
This version installs mods that ship as separate asset packs. CUT Guide 1.1.0 keeps its text and video packs in their folder instead of joining them into one DLL. Older managers are stopped before the download starts.
